Root cause: `grantKeywordTarget-effect-structural.ts`'s own per-keyword SOURCE facts intentionally anchor to the bare keyword WORD only (matching this pool's own the-wind-crystal/moogles-valor precedent), but its SINK fact — unlike its sibling `grantKeywordAll-effect-structural.ts`, which already annotates its own sink with the WHOLE matched clause — was reusing that same bare-word span, so nothing ever covered the "target permanent gains" prefix, and only the clause's FIRST occurrence (Cure) was ever even considered (`clauseMatch = matches[0]`, discarding the rest). Fixed generically, not just for this card: the SINK fact is now built ONCE per group (not once per keyword) and annotated with the WHOLE matched clause for EVERY real occurrence found (usually 1; this card's own Cure/Cura duplicate is the one real case with 2) — same multi-annotation-per-fact pattern `gainLife-effect-structural.ts`'s own fact on this same card already uses for its own Cura/Curaga duplicate lifegain lines. Whole-pool check before landing (all 13 real `grantKeywordTarget` users): re-ran `verify-text-coverage.mjs` on all 13 before/after — only this card's own gap closed (100%, 0 gaps now), none of the other 12 regressed (their own real, separate, pre-existing gaps — Coral Sword/Magitek Scythe/Rosa/Summon: Titan/Gladiolus Amicitia/Haste Magic's own unrelated clauses, Seifer Almasy/Squall's own permanent declines — unchanged). `apply-recognizers.mjs` scoped to all 13: 0 new facts, only identity-merge bookkeeping changes (the per-keyword sink facts that used to be 2 separate identity groups for a 2-keyword card now collapse into 1). `verify-synergy.mjs` scoped to all 13: 0 hard failures. `npx vitest run` (both this recognizer's own test and `grantKeywordAll`'s, the sibling whose sink-annotation convention this now matches): 14/14 passed, updated the Restoration Magic test's own sink expectation + added a literal-substring regression guard. Real oracle text (data/fin/fin_scryfall.json, collector_number 30): "Tiered (Choose one additional cost.)\n• Cure — {0} — Target permanent gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn.\n• Cura — {1} — Target permanent gains hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. You gain 3 life.\n• Curaga — {3}{W} — Permanents you control gain hexproof and indestructible until end of turn. You gain 6 life." Mana cost {W}, type line 'Instant' — both verified against fin_scryfall.json, unchanged.

Checked precedent for 'Tiered' first (grep across the pool): fire-magic/ice-magic/thunder-magic/louisoix-s-sacrifice/vincent-s-limit-break/tifa-s-limit-break all already model it as a real `modal` Effect (per-mode cost/text carried in `describe` only, same documentary-cost tradeoff `modal` already accepts pool-wide — no Effect kind tracks a per-mode COST). Unlike those cards (and unlike Battle Menu, the real 'choose one of several genuinely different effects' modal precedent, which gets one Fact PER MODE), this card's three tiers are ONE real escalating effect — same hexproof+indestructible grant, widening SCOPE (single chosen permanent -> every permanent you control) plus a lifegain bonus at the two higher tiers — so facts are compacted by SCOPE, not exploded per tier: a 'targeted' pair (Cure+Cura share it) and a 'broadcast' pair (Curaga only), not 3x duplicates of the same grant.

Real engine gap found and fixed (card.ts): `grantKeywordTarget`'s `validType?: 'creature' | 'any'` field was declared in the Effect union's own type but the `applyEffect` switch case never read it at all — every real caller in the pool only ever needed a creature-only pool, so the field silently did nothing. Fixed to honor `validType` (default 'creature' when omitted, preserving every existing caller's behavior unchanged) via the shared `battlefieldPool` helper, enabling a real 'any permanent' pool for the first time. Also added a new `grantKeywordAll` predicate value, `'permanents-you-control'` (alongside the original `'creatures-you-control'`), for Curaga's own real 'Permanents you control' broadcast scope — additive, not a behavior change to any existing `'creatures-you-control'` caller. Both fixes are narrowly scoped, additive-only; confirmed via full-pool verify-synergy.mjs (no new failures traceable to this change) and find-synergies.mjs (no other card's own facts touched by this change, since find-synergies only reads Facts, never executes card.ts).

Final facts (7 source, 1 sink), all -1 value sentinel (none run through compute-weights.mjs yet), all real annotations baked via compute-annotations.mjs off a new annotations-authoring.json: self-cast {event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'} and self-graveyard {to:'Graveyard', subject:'self'} (both typeLine-anchored on 'Instant' — mirrors fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own real self-cast/self-graveyard pair, no presence-shaped source, an Instant has no entersBattlefield/dies for itself). grant-hexproof-targeted / grant-indestructible-targeted: {event:'grantKeyword', keyword:<K>, target:{}, targeted:true} (empty Constraints = genuinely unrestricted 'target permanent', any permanent either side — CR 601.2c real targeting language, so `targeted:true` applies), anchored on Cure's own line (the clause is verbatim-identical on Cura's line too; `computeFactAnnotations`'s indexOf naturally resolves to the first, Cure, occurrence). grant-hexproof-broadcast / grant-indestructible-broadcast: {event:'grantKeyword', keyword:<K>, controller:'you', target:{}}, anchored on Curaga's own line — no `targeted` field (same as Dion, Bahamut's Dominant's own real anthem-style grantKeyword fact: an unconditional 'Permanents you control have X' broadcast uses no CR 'target' language at all, so the targeted/broadcast axis doesn't apply, not 'reviewed and confirmed false'). lifegain: {event:'lifegain', controller:'you'}, anchored on Curaga's own 'You gain 6 life.' (the larger, more complete number, same 'steep-bucketed' choice the old pre-migration schema already made). Sink (unchanged in substance from the old schema, reshaped): {to:'Battlefield'} — Restoration Magic's own real 'wants a legal permanent to target' requirement (Cure/Cura only; genuinely unconstrained, unlike fate-of-the-sun-cryst's own 'nonland' restriction, since this card's real text has no type restriction at all), anchored on 'Target permanent'.

One scenario (not more) per the explicit standing rule for a single escalating/tiered-cost effect (not a real 'choose one of several different effects' modal) — Curaga (mode 2, real broadcast + real lifegain, the most complete demonstration), 2 creatures + 1 artifact on the battlefield so the broadcast grant visibly reaches more than one permanent type. Regenerated trace.json via run-scenarios.mjs. Real fn:'grantKeyword' trace lines exist for both keywords via Curaga; verify-synergy.mjs's own reverse-evidence check for `event:'grantKeyword'` doesn't compare the specific `keyword` field (pre-existing looseness, not introduced here — confirmed by reading its own matching predicate), so the two Cure/Cura-only 'targeted' facts pass on that same trace evidence too, even though mode 0/1 aren't separately exercised; flagged as a real, pre-existing softness in the checker, not something this task's scope covers fixing.

Added 'restoration-magic' to scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs's ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS. verify-synergy.mjs: scoped OK (0 hard failures); full pool 315 v2 cards checked, 11 hard failures — all pre-existing/concurrent (ashe-princess-of-dalmasca, auron-s-inspiration, cloudbound-moogle, crystal-fragments-summon-alexander, delivery-moogle, dion-bahamut-s-dominant-bahamut-warden-of-light, dwarven-castle-guard, fate-of-the-sun-cryst, phoenix-down, sidequest-catch-a-fish-cooking-campsite, ultima-origin-of-oblivion — confirmed dion's own failure is byte-identical with card.ts's `grantKeywordTarget`/`grantKeywordAll` fix stashed out, i.e. unrelated to this task's own card.ts edits). vitest run functional-model: 237/238 (the 1 failure is annotation-coverage.test.ts flagging magitek-infantry, a concurrent peer session's own in-flight card added to ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS before its synergy.json was annotated — unrelated to restoration-magic, which itself produces zero violations). find-synergies.mjs real before/after diff (restoration-magic's own facts only, HEAD's old synergy.json vs. the new one): the 13 real graveyard-presence matches relabel from 'graveyard presence' to 'moves to graveyard' (expected `zone`->`to` rename, zero count change), the 3 real lifegain matches (Aerith Gainsborough, Excalibur II, Minwu, White Mage) are unchanged, and 0 new/lost matches from the 6 new grantKeyword facts (confirmed: no sink anywhere in the pool wants `event:'grantKeyword'` yet, same 'promotes vocabulary, doesn't itself create a match' outcome pump/etc. saw on their own promotion passes).
knownGaps: Resolved 2026-09-12 (was open since the pre-migration pass): 'no keyword-grant Effect shape exists yet' — `grantKeywordTarget`/`grantKeywordAll` are both real, mechanically-enforced machinery now (state.ts's own `grantKeyword` mutates the real card's `keywords`), including the two new additions this card forced (`validType:'any'`, `predicate:'permanents-you-control'`). Cure/Cura/Curaga's hexproof+indestructible grants are all real and executed, not documentary-only.

Duration isn't tracked for any keyword grant in this model (same caveat every `grantKeyword*` Effect kind's own doc comment states) — the hexproof/indestructible grant is permanent within a scenario rather than expiring 'until end of turn' the way the real card says. Shared, pre-existing, pool-wide limitation, not unique to this card.
